text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card: 21.0% vs 4.1% expected, risk score 5.55, z 3.03, 43% low-complexity share, 18 documented claims, 1 of 5 documented 99215 claims below billed level, 0 of 12 data-reviewed. Language is cautious (\"reason to review, not a finding\"). Cited claims fit their sentences: C0085405 is documented moderate/36 min against billed 99215, and the other three are low-complexity 99215 claims. Next steps are concrete. Weaknesses: the headline rests on a tiny sample (1 of 5) and presents 20% without caveating it; the 0% comparison baseline is stated but not caveated as a small sample; the \"0 of 12\" finding is included without explaining it is a null result; and the missing documentation (93% of claims lack records) is not flagged as a limitation. Also, 4 of the 99215 documented claims were supported, which is omitted from the rationale.","problems":["Headline leads with a 1-of-5 result, which is statistically thin, with no small-sample caveat","Does not flag that only 7.4% of claims have documentation, so the documented sample may not be representative","Omits that 4 of 5 documented 99215 claims were supported by documentation, which weakens the leaning","The 0-of-12 data-reviewed line is a null finding with no interpretation","Examples are mostly low-complexity claims without records, so they show complexity mismatch but not documentation support","Next step on the sampling plan is generic"]}
